t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Colours are the things to keep track of. Take note of which colour gives you the most mushrooms. Once a break is initiated, and you begin a new round, the colours change in relation to how many mushrooms you will receive.

vb_textbox.text: Focusing on the colours is the most important aspect, what side they are, didn't seem too relevant, it would be colour > shape > side. Once you have a mental note on the colours and how many they give, you're pretty much set.
